mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDERS ( ORDER_ID, MEMBER_ID, ADDRESS_ID, REQUEST_MSG, ORDER_NAME, TOTAL_PRICE, COUPON_DISCOUNT, DELIVERY_FEE, PAYMENT_PRICE, MEMBER_COUPON_ID, TOSS_ORDER_ID ) VALUES ( #{order_id}, #{member_id}, #{dto.addressId}, #{dto.requestMsg}, #{dto.orderName}, #{dto.totalPrice}, #{dto.couponDiscount}, #{dto.deliveryFee}, #{dto.paymentPrice}, #{dto.memberCouponId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{dto.tossOrderId} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.BRAND_ID FROM PRODUCT_OPTION po JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = po.PRODUCT_ID WHERE po.PRODUCT_OPTION_ID = #{productOptionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDERS_DETAIL ( ORDERS_DETAIL_ID, ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_OPTION_ID, BRAND_ID, IMG_URL, PRODUCT_NAME, OPTION_NAME, PRICE, QUANTITY ) VALUES ( SEQ_ORDERS_DETAIL.NEXTVAL, #{order_id}, #{dto.productOptionId}, #{dto.brandId}, #{dto.imgUrl}, #{dto.productName}, #{dto.optionName}, #{dto.price}, #{dto.quantity} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.PRODUCT_ID, od.ORDERS_DETAIL_ID, od.ORDER_ID, od.PRODUCT_NAME,od.img_url as image_url , od.OPTION_NAME,od.PRICE, od.QUANTITY,b.BRAND_ID, b.BRAND_NAME,od.DELIVERY_STATUS, od.DELIVERED_DATE,od.PURCHASE_CONFIRMED_DATE FROM ORDERS_DETAIL od JOIN BRAND b ON od.brand_id = b.brand_id JOIN PRODUCT p ON od.PRODUCT_NAME = p.PRODUCT_NAME WHERE od.ORDER_ID = #{order_id}

SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN od.DELIVERY_STATUS = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paymentCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN od.DELIVERY_STATUS = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS preparingCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN od.DELIVERY_STATUS = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS shippingCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN od.DELIVERY_STATUS = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deliveredCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN od.DELIVERY_STATUS IN (5, 12) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS confirmedCount FROM ORDERS_DETAIL od JOIN ORDERS o ON od.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID WHERE o.MEMBER_ID = #{member_id}

SELECT c.coupon_name ,c.discount_type ,c.discount_value ,c.min_order_price ,c.max_discount ,c.start_date ,c.end_date ,mc.member_coupon_id ,mc.issued_date ,mc.used_date ,mc.status FROM coupon c JOIN member_coupon mc ON c.coupon_id = mc.coupon_id WHERE mc.member_id = #{member_id}
